```{r}
Cal_gam <- gam(                 #Starting a spatial model
  ED_max_calories_m3 ~          #Setting ED max as the response 
    s(max_depth) +              #maximum depth
    Month+                      #month as a factor
    s(long, lat, by=Month),     #a lat long smooth with month as a factor 
  family = tw(),                #modelling with a tweedie family distribution 
  method = "REML",              #Using REML 
  select = TRUE,                #Applying shrinkage
  data   = depth_of_Calmax      #calling the relevant df 
)

summary(Cal_gam)               #summarising the GAM
plot(Cal_gam)                  #Plotting the GAMs
gam.check(Cal_gam)             #Plotting GAM check plots 
```

```{r}
LatLongStations=depth_of_Calmax%>%select(lat, long)          #creating a latlong df 
write.csv(LatLongStations, "C:/Shreya/NARW Thesis/Data/LatLongStationsCal.csv")   #saving it as a csv 
```

```{r}
#creating a prediction hull based on my sampling stations so I am only interpolating
station_hull <- LatLongStations |>                       #working with LatLongStations df 
  st_as_sf(coords = c("long", "lat"), crs = 4326) |>     #Converts lat and long into sf spatial objects using WGS84
  st_union() |>                                          #combining stations points into one workable object 
  st_convex_hull()                                       #drawing a hull around my stations

land <- ne_states(country = "united states of america", returnclass = "sf")     #calls the US states as a spatial sf object 
land <- st_crop(land, xmin = -70.65, xmax = -70.00, ymin = 41.65, ymax = 42.10)   #specifying the area of land I need for this study

df_ocean_sub <- df_ocean |>                      #creating a new subset of df_ocean
  filter(
    lon >= -70.55,
    lon <= -70.10,
    lat >= 41.749,
    lat <= 42.060
  )                                              #filtering only relevant lat and longs based on stations

model_month_levels <- levels(Cal_gam$model$Month)              #getting the month levels 
depth_range <- range(depth_of_Calmax$max_depth, na.rm = TRUE)  #getting the depth range to only predict within sampled depth

all_pred <- df_ocean_sub |>                               #preparing prediction grid 
  rename(long = lon) |>                                   #renaming lon as long to match df
  select(long, lat, depth_m) |>                           #Selecting only relevant columns
  rename(max_depth = depth_m) |>                          #renaming depth_m to max_depth to match df
  tidyr::crossing(Month = factor(model_month_levels, levels = model_month_levels))   #creating prediction locations for all 5 months

all_pred$ED_max_calories_m3 <- predict(Cal_gam, newdata = all_pred, type = "response")      #predicting ED_max for every month on the response scale 

all_pred <- all_pred |>                                                              
  mutate(
    ED_max_calories_m3 = ifelse(max_depth < depth_range[1] | max_depth > depth_range[2], NA, ED_max_calories_m3)
  )           #masking any predictions outside the depth range 


all_pred_sf <- st_as_sf(all_pred, coords = c("long", "lat"), crs = 4326, remove = FALSE)  #Converting prediction locations into spatial sf points 
all_pred_sf$in_hull  <- lengths(st_intersects(all_pred_sf, station_hull)) > 0     #determining which predictions are inside the hull
all_pred_sf$on_land  <- lengths(st_intersects(all_pred_sf, land)) > 0       #determing which predictions are on land

all_pred <- all_pred_sf |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  mutate(ED_max_calories_m3 = ifelse(!in_hull | on_land, NA, ED_max_calories_m3))      #dropping any predictions that are on land or outside the convex hull

fill_limits <- range(all_pred$ED_max_calories_m3, na.rm = TRUE)   #finds the min and max predicted ED for colour scale


make_suitability_map <- function(selected_month) {       #creating a function to make ED map per month
  new_data_suitability_tweedie <- df_ocean_sub |>        #creating prediction for each month
    rename(long = lon) |>
    mutate(Month = factor(selected_month, levels = model_month_levels),
           max_depth = df_ocean_sub$depth_m)

  pred_suitability <- predict(Cal_gam, newdata = new_data_suitability_tweedie,   #predicting ED for every month
                               type = "response", se.fit = TRUE)   #with the response and residuals 
  new_data_suitability_tweedie$ED_max_calories_m3 <- pred_suitability$fit    #storing the fit of the prediction as ED_max in my df

#masking within the depth range and making everything out of depth range NA
  new_data_suitability_tweedie <- new_data_suitability_tweedie |>  
    mutate(
      ED_max_calories_m3 = ifelse(
        max_depth < depth_range[1] | max_depth > depth_range[2],
        NA, ED_max_calories_m3
      )
    )

  pred_sf <- st_as_sf(new_data_suitability_tweedie, coords = c("long", "lat"),
                      crs = 4326, remove = FALSE)                               #converting prediction points into sf spatial object
  pred_sf$in_hull <- lengths(st_intersects(pred_sf, station_hull)) > 0    #identifying points inside hull
  pred_sf$on_land <- lengths(st_intersects(pred_sf, land)) > 0            #identifying points on land

  new_data_suitability_tweedie <- pred_sf |> 
    st_drop_geometry() |>
    mutate(ED_max_calories_m3 = ifelse(!in_hull | on_land, NA, ED_max_calories_m3))   #keeping only points within hull and within depth range
  

pred_points <- new_data_suitability_tweedie |>
  st_as_sf(coords = c("long", "lat"), crs = 4326, remove = FALSE)   #creating an sf object of predictions

#Whale sightings as sf spatial object points for each month 
RW_Sightings_month <- RW_Sightings |>
  mutate(sighting_month = as.numeric(format(as.Date(date, format = "%d-%b-%y"), "%m"))) |>    #extracting month from the date
  filter(sighting_month == selected_month) |>      #filtering only sightings from the selected month
  rename(long = Longitude, lat = Latitude) |>      #renaming lat and long to df names
  filter(!is.na(long), !is.na(lat)) |>             #removing any NA's in long and late
  mutate(category = "NARW sighting") |>            #adding a column for NARW sightings
  st_as_sf(coords = c("long", "lat"), crs = 4326, remove = FALSE)   #converts whale sightings into spatial sf points

idx <- st_nearest_feature(RW_Sightings_month, pred_points)   #finding the nearest prediction point for every NARW sighting

#removing any sightings outside prediction area
RW_Sightings_month <- RW_Sightings_month[
  !is.na(pred_points$ED_max_calories_m3[idx]),    
] |>
  st_drop_geometry()
  
  ggplot() +    #starting a ggplot
    geom_raster(data = new_data_suitability_tweedie,
                aes(x = long, y = lat, fill = ED_max_calories_m3),
                interpolate = TRUE, na.rm = TRUE) +            #creates the ED max map 
    geom_sf(data = land, fill = "grey70", color = "black", inherit.aes = FALSE) +   #plots land mass onto the map
    geom_point(data = RW_Sightings_month, 
               aes(x = long, y = lat, shape = category, color = category),
               size = 0.4, show.legend = FALSE) +                               #plots NARW sightings of every month
    coord_sf(xlim = c(-70.65, -70.00), ylim = c(41.65, 42.10), expand = FALSE) +  #forces geographic extent of map
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(-70.6, -70.4, -70.2, -70.0)) +     #setting x-axis sclae 
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(41.7, 41.9, 42.1))+      #setting y-axis scale 
    scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "turbo", limits = fill_limits, na.value = NA, name = "Calories Max") +   #makes a colour scale for ED max
    scale_color_manual(name = "Legend", values = c("NARW sighting" = "violetred3")) +   #setting colour of NARW sightings manually
    annotation_scale(location = "bl") +     #scale bar on bottom left 
    annotation_north_arrow(location = "bl", style = north_arrow_fancy_orienteering(), height = unit(0.9, "cm"), width = unit(0.9,                            "cm"), pad_x = unit(0.05, "cm"), pad_y = unit(0.7,"cm")) +    #setting north arrow
    labs(subtitle = month.name[selected_month], x = NULL, y = NULL) +   #creating a month title above each map
    theme_minimal()+      #creating a theme
    theme(
      plot.subtitle = element_text(    #formatting month labels to be bigger and bold and centred 
      size = 14,
      face = "bold",
     hjust = 0.5
  ))}

#calling the function for each month 
p_jan <- make_suitability_map(1)  
p_feb <- make_suitability_map(2)
p_mar <- make_suitability_map(3)
p_apr <- make_suitability_map(4)
p_may <- make_suitability_map(5)

#getting the legend from one map
legend_ED <- get_legend(
  p_jan + theme(legend.position = "right")
)

#turns the legend into a plot
legend_plot_ED <- cowplot::ggdraw(legend_ED)

#Remove the legend from all maps
p_jan_noleg <- p_jan + theme(legend.position = "none")
p_feb_noleg <- p_feb + theme(legend.position = "none")
p_mar_noleg <- p_mar + theme(legend.position = "none")
p_apr_noleg <- p_apr + theme(legend.position = "none")
p_may_noleg <- p_may + theme(legend.position = "none")

#combine all maps with legend plot 
combined_fig <-
  (p_jan_noleg + p_feb_noleg + p_mar_noleg) /
  (p_apr_noleg + p_may_noleg + legend_plot_ED)

combined_fig   #call on the figure to view 

#save the whole plot on an A4 size png 
ggsave(
  filename = "combined_fig_ED.png",
  plot = combined_fig,
  width = 11.69,
  height = 8.27,
  units = "in",
  dpi = 600,
  bg = "white"
)
```
